lines.text: 两只小老鼠掉进奶油桶：一只放弃淹死了；另一只拼命搅打，把奶油搅成黄油，然后爬了出来。
lines.en: Two little mice fell in a bucket of cream. The first mouse quickly gave up and drowned. The second mouse wouldn't quit... He churned that cream into butter and crawled out.
lines.note: 父子相传的寓言，片尾回响成人生方法论。
